title: Possessed by the Dark Side
front_description: A grief-stricken Anakin returns to the Lars family with the body of his mother. Later, alone with Padmé, he loses control of his emotions and confesses to a terrible crime. "I... I killed them," Anakin snaps, referring to the encamped Tusken Raiders. "And not just the men, but the women and the children, too!" Ihe young Jedi seems stunned by his own frightful words. "Tbey're like animals, and I slaughtered them like animals. I hate them!"
back_description: George Lucas poses with Tusken Raiders, catalysts for Anakin's Dark Side fury.
